name: pintag-unit-types-tests
description: Regression coverage for a reported bug: a Unit Type card named "2 Bedroom 1 Bath" was rejected by the publish validator because the structured Bedrooms/Bathrooms fields were empty, even though the title states both numbers. Fixed by parseUnitTypeTitle() (terminology.js), wired into the Unit Type Name field (admin.html) so Bedrooms/Bathrooms auto-populate from a recognized title pattern, with manual edits always taking precedence over anything inferred from the title.
